chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
A small family is one of the two ways of ease.

key_terms.الْيَسَارَيْنِ: the two easements or forms of ease

ai.seo_question: What is the benefit of having a small family according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: In this saying from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) identifies having few dependents as one of the two forms of 'Yasir' (ease/wealth), contrasting it with the other form being contentment with sufficiency. This reflects the Shia scholarly understanding that financial ease is not merely about abundance but also about the manageable burden of responsibility, emphasizing moderation in family size to preserve spiritual and economic well-being.

en.sayed-ali-raza: 141. Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, said:
A small family is one of the ways of (securing) ease.
